qualityAnnotation: Faded poses use interpolated tracking boxes or source boxes overlapping at least 60% of the smaller box; visibility and contact remain unverified.

roomCalibration.method: Gaussian scan landmarks matched to stationary footage features; robust PnP source-camera poses; floor leveling; per-frame camera stabilization
roomCalibration.scaleBasis: Existing reconstruction model meters, anchored to the authoritative frame-0 source-camera height. Physical scale is unmeasured.
roomCalibration.note: Scan-calibrated camera stabilization; original estimated anatomy, depth and within-frame contacts are preserved.
